azdoPatSteps.step1: In Azure DevOps, open your profile (top right) and go to User Settings > Personal Access Tokens.
azdoPatSteps.step2: Click "New Token", give it a name, and set scopes to Work Items (Read) and Test Plans (Read).
azdoPatSteps.step3: Click "Create" and copy the token right away - Azure DevOps only shows it once.
azdoPatSteps.step4: In the dashboard, click "Change PAT" (or use the first-run screen) and paste your organization name plus PAT.
azdoPatSteps.step5: The values stay only in this browser's local storage and are sent only to your local dashboard process.

kpisHelp.totalTestCases: All test cases in the selected plan, regardless of their status.
kpisHelp.executedCount: Cases with outcome Passed, Failed or Blocked. Not Applicable (N/A) cases are excluded.
kpisHelp.notApplicable: Cases marked Not Applicable (N/A), i.e. not relevant for this sprint.
kpisHelp.notRun: Cases not executed yet: Total minus Executed minus N/A.
kpisHelp.passRate: Percentage of Passed cases over the total usable cases (Total minus N/A). N/A cases are excluded.
kpisHelp.effectiveBugsDetected: Valid bugs found, excluding out-of-scope ones (duplicates, not relevant, etc.).
kpisHelp.outOfScopeBugsDetected: Bugs found but excluded from the main count because they're out of scope (duplicates, not reproducible, not relevant).
kpisHelp.bugsByUs: Bugs found by our test team (Total minus the ones opened by DSI).
kpisHelp.bugsByDsi: Bugs reported directly by DSI, not found by our test team.
kpisHelp.bugsClosedRatio: Percentage of Closed bugs over the total bugs found (Closed divided by Total).
kpisHelp.criticalBugs: Critical-severity bugs that are still open. Already-closed critical bugs aren't counted here.
kpisHelp.reopenedBugs: Bugs that were closed and got reopened because the issue came back.
kpisHelp.avgClosureTime: Average number of days between a bug being opened and closed.
kpisHelp.withoutResolutionDate: Closed bugs missing a resolution date in the system, so they don't contribute to the average closure time.
